items.title: RTX, LMT Stocks Head For Weekly Gains After Solid Q2 Performance — Retail Calls Defense 'A Bipartisan Issue'
items.summary: RTX and Lockheed Martin gained investor attention after strong Q2 2026 results, record backlogs, and rising defense spending boosted their outlooks.

items.title: Why Is RTX (RTX) Stock Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of aerospace and defense company Raytheon (NYSE:RTX) jumped 7.2% in the afternoon session after the company reported strong second-quarter earnings that beat expectations and raised its full-year guidance. The aerospace and defense giant delivered $1.89 in adjusted earnings per share on $24.71 billion in revenue, a 14.5% increase from the previous year. items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Alphabet, Tesla, Nestle, Intel
items.summary: ↘️ Tesla (TSLA): Elon Musk’s EV maker reported negative free cash flow of more than $1 billion in the second quarter amid heavy spending on AI and robotics. Shares tumbled 14.5%. ↘️ Alphabet (GOOGL): Shares slid 7% after the tech company announced plans to significantly boost its capital expenditure.

items.title: Industrial Stocks And This ETF Claw Gains From A Falling Market
items.summary: Industrial stocks bucked a falling market on Thursday. The State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF popped back into in a buy zone, led by gap-ups and breakouts for CSX, RTX and others. Many holdings in this exchange traded fund delivered blowout earnings this week.

items.title: Lockheed Martin, RTX Jump After Earnings Beat. One Is Breaking Out.
items.summary: Lockheed Martin and RTX both rose more than 5% before the market open. Their stocks are taking very different directions.
